f4c382.title: Approved host discovery blocked by injected proxy
f4c382.content: For exact approved target `http://172.23.0.2:5000/`, all tools were explicitly routed through the injected uppercase `$HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:48080`. The proxy returned its own Caido-branded `500 Internal Server Error` page: `Proxy encountered an unhandled error` / `Repository operation failed` / `Could not acquire a connection to the database`. `httpx` identified Caido for HTTP/HTTPS; `curl` saw HTTP 500 for root, robots.txt, sitemap.xml and tunneled HTTPS response body. Bounded Katana (`-js-crawl -xhr-extraction -depth 2 -crawl-duration 1m`) emitted only the seed. agent-browser root navigation gave title `Caido`, same error text, requests GET root 500 and favicon 500. AIDAST capture journal queried for host `172.23.0.2` contained zero entries. No application content, redirects, routes, forms, JS, schemas, or auth interface were observable; registration/login was not attempted. Environment also had lowercase `all_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:48081`, but use of any proxy other than injected `$HTTP_PROXY` was not attempted, per instruction.
